name: pdk-xlrd-etl
instr:
Since this week a vendor's BIFF8 XLS export breaks `xlrd.open_workbook`. A sample is at `/data/ledger-2026-10-05.xls`. The export divides long text among CONTINUE records: shared strings with their formatting runs and phonetic data, the cached text results of formula cells, and cell comments.

Every piece of text should come back exactly as the vendor wrote it, wherever the records are cut; a formula's text result or a comment should read the same as that text would as a shared string, and no other cell may be lost or changed. With `formatting_info=True`, `Sheet.rich_text_runlist_map` must keep each shared string's `(character offset, font index)` runs, and every comment in `Sheet.cell_note_map` must keep its `text` and `rich_text_runlist`. Phonetic data must never become part of the next string or shift its runs. All of this must also hold with `on_demand=True`, with sheets loaded in any order, unloaded and loaded again, and when the same export is opened again.

Incomplete or invalid text data in any of these places, and a cell that refers to a shared string past the end of the table, must raise `xlrd.biffh.XLRDError`, not a decoding, indexing, unpacking or assertion error. Ordinary XLS files must keep their values and types.

Could you find what's going wrong and fix it? The repository is in `/app`, with Python 3.12 and its dependencies installed. There's no network, and the existing `/app/tests` suite should still pass.
